I'm planning to implement changes in the hero_feedback_surface.dart file. The center "Seek HUD" will be swapped for a bottom HUD overlay, which I'll create as a new widget named _SeekBottomHud. We also need to ensure the bottom HUD disappears after gestures, and we’ll remove the central seek indicator. Plus, I'll update the screenshots by generating placeholder images for "During gesture" and "Post gesture."
